name: Call of Fire

angles.text: A foundational trial for shamans communing with fire, requiring the use of a sacred sapta to perceive and confront the spirits of flame.

faq.answer: Call of Fire is a sacred rite of passage where an initiate drinks a specially prepared fire sapta to perceive a spirit of flame, confronts it in combat, and offers its glowing ember to a brazier to earn the favor of fire.
faq.q: What is the Call of Fire?

faq.answer: The fire sapta is a prepared draught that opens an initiate's spiritual sight, allowing them to see the hidden elemental spirit awaiting them at the mountain peak.
faq.q: What is the purpose of the fire sapta?

faq.answer: The trial calls upon the initiate to confront a Minor Manifestation of Fire atop the peak, which waits until struck before engaging in battle.
faq.q: What spirit appears during the trial?

faq.answer: The elemental spirit grows fiercer and hotter the longer the battle draws out, making a swift, decisive strike vital to subduing it before its flames become overwhelming.
faq.q: Why must the fire spirit be defeated quickly?

faq.answer: After defeating the Minor Manifestation of Fire, its glowing embers are carried to the brazier atop the Shrine of Eternal Flame to kindle the ritual torch.
faq.q: What is done with the glowing embers?

faq.answer: Completing the ritual and kindling the torch earns the direct favor and communion of the fire elementals, establishing a vital bond with the flames.
faq.q: What does earning the fire's favor mean?

sections.body: The Call of Fire is a traditional trial of spirit and courage. Guided by elemental lore, an initiate receives a prepared fire sapta to awaken their senses to the unseen world. Upon taking the draught at the shrine and ascending toward the peak, the boundary between mortal eyes and primal forces thins, revealing a dormant manifestation of fire awaiting challenge.
sections.title: The Rite of Flame

sections.body: Confronting the Minor Manifestation of Fire tests both decisiveness and endurance. The elemental spirit does not attack unprovoked, but once challenged, its intensity swells with every passing moment. Overcoming it yields glowing embers, which must be brought to the brazier atop the Shrine of Eternal Flame to kindle the torch and secure the spirit's enduring favor.
sections.title: Facing the Manifestation

summary: The Call of Fire is an elemental trial where an initiate drinks a prepared sapta to perceive and confront a Minor Manifestation of Fire. By subduing the spirit and placing its embers into the sacred brazier, the petitioner earns the favor of the flame.
